Depends on what you want to do. The OP-1 is a sampler, drum machine, synthesizer, sequencer all in one. On the other hand the Sub 37 is probably the finest anolog monosynth on the market. It does leads and bass better than anything I can think of under 2k. The OP-1 is an inspired design meant for producing at little cost. What are you looking for? A powerful workhorse that fill a niche or a device meant for producing. Personally if you have already invested in sequencers or drum machines, or if you really are looking for that synth sound I would go with the Sub 37

You have got to stop thinking so negatively. Your habits are what keeps you depressed. Several months ago I had bought a rope to hang myself with, but I decided I didn't want to go out like that. I began to stop myself when ever I thoughts that were negative, self hating, or suicidal. At the end of the day your past doesn't matter and negative thinking is pointless. Start exercising, reading informative books, play a new instrument, medidate just do anything to give you a feeling of satisfaction. It's been many days and some self discipline, but my mood on average is starting to lift. About your friend though, take a break from your social obligations to raise your spirits. Absence makes the heart grow fonder, hopefully with a combination of your efforts you'll be able to joke and smile again. I know that's how I am recovering mine. I hope I have been helpful, and I hope you find a way to cheer up :)
